display_name: Zero-knob fade of last daily close-to-close after 5d/20d realized-variance expansion; SL=prior-day |C-O|; TP=2R; first H1 signal; flat hour 16
hypothesis: On XAUUSD H1 as stamped by the Vantage terminal clock in xauusd_data.csv (NY-close-aligned server_clock_as_stored; no DST conversion), when the sample variance (ddof=1) of the last 5 completed daily log-close returns is at least 1.5 times the sample variance of the last 20 completed daily log-close returns, fading the sign of the last completed close-to-close move on the next calendar day's first printed H1 (fill next open, SL = prior day's |last_close - first_open|, TP = 2R, force-flat at hour 16) has no free parameters. Daily returns use last H1 close of each completed calendar day only; day T is excluded from the variance state. Any edge must come from that fade after Standard STP spread costs. Thin develop n < soft n_trades_min is SCREEN_FAIL, not a waiver.

clock_contract.source: MqlRates time via Mt5ArchBridge TimeToString; fetch_data tags as UTC without conversion

rule.daily_close: last printed H1 close of calendar day D (completed days only)
rule.daily_open: open of the first printed H1 of calendar day D
rule.daily_log_return: r_D = ln(C_D / C_{D-1}); skip day if C_{D-1}<=0
rule.variance: sample variance of the listed completed daily log returns, ddof=1
rule.expansion: long_var > 0 and short_var / long_var >= 1.5; else no trade that day
rule.state_asof: computed from days strictly before calendar day T; no look-ahead
rule.fade_sign: if C_{T-1} > C_{T-2} then short; if C_{T-1} < C_{T-2} then long; if equal skip
rule.signal_bar: closed H1 only: first printed bar of day T (lowest time that calendar day)
rule.signal_long: expansion and C_{T-1} < C_{T-2} on the first printed H1 close of day T
rule.signal_short: expansion and C_{T-1} > C_{T-2} on the first printed H1 close of day T
rule.entry: if flat and first qualifying signal of the day: fill at open[i+1] only if same calendar day and hour[i+1] <= flat_hour_server; else skip
rule.exit: SL or TP or force flat at close of bar with hour >= flat_hour_server same day; no overnight
rule.thin_n_policy: if develop-eligible trade count < gates.soft.n_trades_min then SCREEN_FAIL; not a waiver; do not lower n_trades_min
rule.rejected_sister_candidate: asia_box vs London displacement — asia_box_london_sweep_fade_flat SCREEN_FAIL; do not implement

null.algorithm: For each calendar day with m bars: (1) ref_0 = open[0], ref_j = close[j-1] for j>0; (2) inc_j = (open,high,low,close)/ref_j componentwise; (3) circularly rotate the m increments by k in {0..m-1}; (4) rebuild continuous OHLC path from the original day open by chaining rotated increments so each bar unit's open/ref and true-range/ref ratios are preserved as a multiset. Timestamps and spreads remain fixed.
null.notes: Canonical session null for protocol 2.2. base_seed=20260820 is the freeze-date convention (no seed shopping). Required because flatten hour and first-bar-of-day geometry are session-shaped even though alpha is multi-day closes.

execution_contract.bar: closed H1 for signal; entry at next bar open

entry.signal: evaluated at close of the first printed H1 of calendar day T
entry.fill: open[i+1] when same calendar day and hour[i+1] <= 16
entry.costs_on_entry_bar: round-trip trade_cost is COMPUTED from entry bar at fill, STORED on the open trade, and DEDUCTED once when exit PnL is booked

costs.measured_at: entry bar (spread_pts, lots sized at entry)

exit.sl_fill: exit at sl price when low<=sl (long) or high>=sl (short)
exit.tp_fill: exit at tp when high>=tp (long) or low<=tp (short), only if stop not hit first
exit.end_of_series: if still in position on last bar of entry day, force close at last close with trade_cost already charged; never carry overnight

sizing.raw_lots: risk_cash / (stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE) with risk_cash = balance * risk_pct; stop_dist = abs(entry - sl)
sizing.skip_if: lots < min_lot OR stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE * min_lot > risk_cash
sizing.balance_source: realized balance (starts at start_balance=10000; compounds on booked pnls)

no_overnight.entry_gate: fill only if hour[i+1] <= 16 same day
no_overnight.day_boundary: if position still open when calendar day changes, fail-closed: do not apply next-day SL/TP

capital.pnl_on_exit: pnl = (exit_px - entry) * CONTRACT_SIZE * lots * direction - trade_cost; direction = +1 long / -1 short
capital.max_drawdown_pct: peak = running maximum of equity series; dd = (peak - eq) / peak; max_drawdown_pct = max(dd) * 100
